name: @miftachurrochim82/frontend-cdn
description: Shared Frontend Assets CDN for Google Apps Script Web Apps (Pemkab Trenggalek) — Vue 3 + Tailwind

scripts.build:js: for f in app-core app-components app-modules app-layout app-ui app-forms app-data app-charts app-workflow; do terser frontend/$f.js -c -m -o frontend/$f.min.js; done
scripts.build:css: cleancss -o frontend/app-common.min.css frontend/app-common.css && cleancss -o frontend/app-tailwind.min.css frontend/app-tailwind.min.css || true
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css

author: miftachurrochim82-sketch
